page.layout: One page of running text, set in one column. Printed page number at the top right. No margin notes. At the foot: gathering signature at left and catchword at right.

main_text.p: fide, uti insigni regio vincitur, & vestitu deaurato, doctrina, quæ nunquam maculam trahit, neque rubigine consenescit, variegata ritibus, & moribus: neque enim omnia quæ in ea sunt, neque actiones omnes exe-dem[?], sed pro varietate temporum, & institutorum humanorum variæ, illius pulchritudinem augent, non tamen mutant, ut sunt ritus, consuetudines, opiniones etiam & quæstiones, quæ circa res sacras, & Theologicas inter doctos viros ad illustrandam illius fidem, non denigrandam per disceptationem decertantur, & in Canticis varijs pomis exprimuntur in uno fructu fide. comedat fructum pomorum tuorum. Quænam autem illa sunt, iam intellexisti ex Paulo, prima ad Corinthios cap. 12.

Dices Hottingere, hoc esse, de quo querimonias ultro citroque iactant Reformati, Pontificios nunquam in ijsdem placitis manere, sed continuata nouitate, ac litura decreta sua in alia, atque alia immutare, & de uno proposito in aliud demigrare. Hinc factum esse, ut antiquis, & sanioribus relictis ad superstitiosa quaeque animum compulerint, & inuerterint omnia, & a puriori illo statu in deteriorem desciuerint. Verum Hottingere, tu qui rectum calles, ideoque nimium tibi tribuis, rerum humanarum

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout; ligatures ss read as ss (esse, desciuerint). The line break "exe-dem" is uncertain: the first part may be a ligature or abbreviation for "eæ", so "exe-dem" is marked [?]. "varijs" and "ijsdem" are printed with a j-form final i and are kept as printed. Italic words are read from the scan; "ritibus", "doctrina", "fide." and "comedat fructum pomorum tuorum" appear in italic, while "moribus" is uncertain. Show-through and edge shading on the left and right edges are not transcribed.
